fairness_gates: Final accusation/solution cannot depend on AUTHOR_ONLY or MEMORY_ONLY items unless current-line corroboration independently supports the decisive claim.
A clue is not its interpretation; alternative_model must remain explicit until excluded by evidence.
Access must be current to the character who acts on the evidence.
Protected clue order cannot be silently changed by audio/marketing adaptation.
Red herrings must resolve into a real lie, secret, crime, relationship fact or institutional failure rather than pure noise.
